newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radicals urge Palestinians to revolt.
newsitem.headline: Radicals urge Palestinians to revolt.

text.p: Radical Palestinian groups on Friday condemned Israel's opening of a tunnel near Moslem holy sites in Jerusalem and urged Palestinians to escalate their struggle against Israel.

The Damascus-based 10-member radical alliance, opposed to peace with Israel, accused Israel in a statement of trying to turn the "Aqsa mosque into a synagogue" and called Arabs to halt all forms of normalisation with the Jewish state.
Seven Palestinians, two Israeli paramilitary policemen and an Israeli soldier were killed in a third day of violence in the West Bank, Gaza Strip and Jerusalem on Friday.
Since Wednesday, 67 people -- 53 Palestinians and 14 Israelis -- have been killed in violence touched off by Israel's opening of the tunnel.

"We call our people inside and outside the occupied lands to to express their anger.. and escalate the struggle against all of the deals of capitulation and betrayal and against all forms of normalisation with the Zionist enemy," it said.

The alliance, including the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine, the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine, the Islamic Jihad and Hamas, has vowed to wreck the PLO-Israeli peace deals for Palestinian self-rule in Gaza and the West Bank.
